autoCompleteNotReady: Available once a foundation builds past its ace

tutorial.foundation: Four empty foundations sit beside the bouquet. Build each pile by suit from Ace to King.
tutorial.reserve: The bouquet holds sixteen single face-up cards. They can leave for the flower beds or a foundation, but nothing ever moves back into the bouquet.
tutorial.tableau: Six open flower beds of six cards each are dealt face-up. Only the rightmost card of each bed is playable.
tutorial.moves: Pack the flower beds in descending rank, suit ignored (any card on the next-higher rank). Empty beds accept any card.
tutorial.controls: Use hint, undo, and auto-complete buttons.

hintReason.toFoundation: Send this card to the foundation to free up the flower bed.
hintReason.toTableau: Apply the suggested flower-bed move to unlock buried cards.
